lines.zh: 我巡视反应堆，骨头踩得咯吱响
lines.en: I tour the reactor; my bones creak.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，负责人不需要赶
lines.en: I walk unhurried; directors don't rush.

lines.zh: 黑骨头走过的地方，草都枯了
lines.en: Where my black bones pass, growth withers.

lines.zh: 我沿着冷却渠走，水面结了壳
lines.en: I pace the cooling channel; its surface crusts.

lines.zh: 每一步都让盖革管叫得更急
lines.en: Each step makes the Geiger counter tick faster.

lines.zh: 我的影子比人长，因为辐射拉长了它
lines.en: My shadow outruns me; radiation stretches it.

lines.zh: 我绕过一堆废料，那是上一任的
lines.en: I skirt a scrap heap; it was my predecessor.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头是我的办公室，没有门
lines.en: My office is at the corridor's end; no door.

lines.zh: 我用剑柄敲管子，听它有没有裂
lines.en: I tap pipes with my hilt to hear cracks.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里漏出的光，是反应堆的颜色
lines.en: Light leaks from my bones: reactor green.

lines.zh: 我巡视一圈，记下每个不合格的人
lines.en: One round, and I note every unqualified soul.

lines.zh: 灰从我身上落下，像在签文件
lines.en: Ash falls off me like signatures.

lines.zh: 我站着听反应堆的低鸣，很安心
lines.en: I listen to the reactor's hum; comforting.

lines.zh: 手指敲着剑脊，一下，两下
lines.en: My fingers tap the blade's spine: one, two.

lines.zh: 我在算这批人的辐射剂量
lines.en: I'm calculating this batch's dose.

lines.zh: 办公室太吵，我出来静一静
lines.en: The office is loud; I step out for quiet.

lines.zh: 骨头不需要坐，我靠着管道就行
lines.en: Bones need no chair; I lean on a pipe.

lines.zh: 我把剑插进地里，等它凉一点
lines.en: I plant my blade and let it cool.

lines.zh: 这层的灯坏了三盏，没人报修
lines.en: Three lamps died here; nobody filed it.

lines.zh: 我记得每个下属的编号，和下场
lines.en: I recall every subordinate's number and fate.

lines.zh: 反应堆在数自己的心跳，我也在数
lines.en: The reactor counts beats; so do I.

lines.zh: 绿色的光在我肋骨间慢慢转
lines.en: Green light turns slowly between my ribs.

lines.zh: 你站得离反应堆太近了，我记一笔
lines.en: Too close to the reactor; noted.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼神，像看一份报废申请
lines.en: I look at you like a scrapping request.

lines.zh: 你的皮肤已经开始发灰了，别挠
lines.en: Your skin is greying; don't scratch.

lines.zh: 我认得那身装备，上一任也穿它
lines.en: I know that gear; my predecessor wore it.

lines.zh: 你不敢直视我，这很好
lines.en: You won't meet my gaze; good.

lines.zh: 你数我的骨头？数不完的
lines.en: Counting my bones? You'll run out.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看一份不合格的报表
lines.en: I look down as at a failed report.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸很快，剂量在起效
lines.en: Quick breaths; the dose is working.

lines.zh: 我看你不像来述职的
lines.en: You don't look like you're here to report.

lines.zh: 别站在风口，那里的读数最高
lines.en: Not by the vent; readings peak there.

lines.zh: 你砍断我一根骨头，我还有别的
lines.en: You break a bone; I have others.

lines.zh: 伤口冒绿烟，不流血
lines.en: The wound smokes green, not blood.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起上一任的结局
lines.en: That reminds me how my predecessor ended.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，登记表上记你一笔
lines.en: I step back; your file gains a note.

lines.zh: 剑刃崩了个口，不影响签字
lines.en: My blade nicked; signing still works.

lines.zh: 疼是活人的事，我借一点
lines.en: Pain belongs to the living; I borrow it.

lines.zh: 你打中肋骨缝，运气不错
lines.en: You hit a rib gap; lucky.

lines.zh: 绿光暗了一下，又亮起来
lines.en: My green light dims, then returns.

lines.zh: 我扶住管道，铁皮立刻生锈
lines.en: I grip the pipe; rust blooms at once.

lines.zh: 你砍得动我，砍不动这层楼
lines.en: You can cut me; not this floor.

lines.zh: 你把金子放地上，辐射会替你收着
lines.en: Leave gold down; the radiation will keep it.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我的骨头只吸收剂量
lines.en: I don't eat; my bones absorb dose.

lines.zh: 拿食物引诱总监，写进你的档案
lines.en: Baiting the director goes in your file.

lines.zh: 你晃什么，我的剑比它亮
lines.en: Whatever you wave, my blade shines brighter.

lines.zh: 我早就没有胃口了，只有职责
lines.en: I lost my appetite; duty remains.

lines.zh: 想用甜头换通行证，驳回
lines.en: Bribery for a pass: denied.

lines.zh: 那东西放在托盘里，也不合格
lines.en: Even on a tray, it fails inspection.

lines.zh: 我盯了三秒，你就该收起来
lines.en: Three seconds of my stare; put it away.

lines.zh: 我不用进食，这层楼喂我
lines.en: I need no meals; this floor feeds me.

lines.zh: 你把好东西留着，路上会用上
lines.en: Keep your valuables; you'll need them.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一排铁柜
lines.en: You hit me like a row of iron cabinets.

lines.zh: 我的骨头很轻，站得却很稳
lines.en: My bones are light; my stance isn't.

lines.zh: 让开，这条走廊通控制台
lines.en: Move; this hall leads to the console.

lines.zh: 你贴过来，袖口沾了一层灰
lines.en: You brushed me; ash coats your cuff.

lines.zh: 我不推人，我只把路占满
lines.en: I don't shove; I occupy the road.

lines.zh: 你被弹开一步，站稳了再说
lines.en: You bounce a step; steady yourself first.

lines.zh: 撞我之前，先想想离职流程
lines.en: Before ramming me, consider the exit process.

lines.zh: 我肩上是旧甲片，比你硬
lines.en: My shoulder wears old plate; harder than yours.

lines.zh: 走廊很窄，我不打算侧身
lines.en: The hall is narrow; I won't turn sideways.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的剑就不会抬起来
lines.en: Step aside and my blade stays down.

lines.zh: 我不繁殖，我只任命
lines.en: I don't breed; I appoint.

lines.zh: 总监没有伴侣，只有下属
lines.en: A director has subordinates, not a partner.

lines.zh: 你把两个我放一起，会争夺职位
lines.en: Two of me would fight for the post.

lines.zh: 别拿牲口那套对我，我是管理岗
lines.en: Don't use livestock logic; I'm management.

lines.zh: 我的后代是文件，不是小骷髅
lines.en: My legacy is paperwork, not little skeletons.

lines.zh: 这里不办喜事，只办交接
lines.en: No weddings here; only handovers.

lines.zh: 我连自己的骨头都管不好
lines.en: I can't even keep my own bones in line.

lines.zh: 配对申请先走流程，我不批
lines.en: File a pairing request; I'll refuse it.

lines.zh: 火气太旺的地方，长不出新东西
lines.en: Nothing new grows where it burns this hot.

lines.zh: 你问这个，我记你态度不端正
lines.en: Asking that earns you a poor attitude note.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，地上东西归废料区
lines.en: I don't bend; floor items go to scrap.

lines.zh: 那枚零件我拿了，登记为公物
lines.en: I take that part and log it as state property.

lines.zh: 捡东西这种事，交给下属
lines.en: Picking things up is for subordinates.

lines.zh: 你掉的，写份遗失报告
lines.en: You dropped it; file a loss report.

lines.zh: 我手上有剑，腾不出来
lines.en: My hand holds a blade; no room.

lines.zh: 地上的东西都带辐射，别碰
lines.en: Everything on the floor is hot; leave it.

lines.zh: 我拾起来只会让它锈得更快
lines.en: If I pick it up, it rusts faster.

lines.zh: 归置物品不在我的职责表里
lines.en: Tidying isn't on my duty sheet.

lines.zh: 你把它踢到墙角，我当没看见
lines.en: Kick it to the corner; I saw nothing.

lines.zh: 这层楼的东西，最终都归反应堆
lines.en: Everything on this floor ends in the reactor.

lines.zh: 未经许可进入反应堆区，处理掉
lines.en: Unauthorized reactor entry; processing.

lines.zh: 我把剑从地里拔出来，泥土发黑
lines.en: I pull my blade free; the soil blackens.

lines.zh: 你的编号进了待办清单，排在最后
lines.en: You're on the queue; last in line.

lines.zh: 这层的空气已经替你做了决定
lines.en: This floor's air has decided for you.

lines.zh: 我看见你的护符了，它挡不住辐射
lines.en: I see your charm; it won't stop radiation.

lines.zh: 请示驳回，我现在就动手
lines.en: Request denied; I proceed now.

lines.zh: 你踩到了警戒线，那是我的线
lines.en: You crossed the cordon; my cordon.

lines.zh: 骨头里的绿光转快了，你该懂
lines.en: My bone-light quickens; you should know why.

lines.zh: 别举手，这里不接收申诉
lines.en: Don't raise a hand; no appeals here.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的铁锈和汗，新鲜
lines.en: I smell iron and sweat on you; fresh.

lines.zh: 上一任也站在那位置，后来没了
lines.en: My predecessor stood there too; then wasn't.

lines.zh: 你要见总监，我就是
lines.en: You asked for the director; that's me.

lines.zh: 反应堆醒了，它先看到你
lines.en: The reactor woke; it saw you first.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我只签字
lines.en: I don't chase; I sign off.

lines.zh: 你的名字还没写进名册，算了
lines.en: Your name never made the roster; never mind.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，你退得很急
lines.en: My pace is steady; your retreat isn't.

lines.zh: 你往冷却渠跑，渠水是热的
lines.en: Run to the channel; the water's hot.

lines.zh: 我把剑横过来，走廊就窄了
lines.en: I turn my blade; the corridor narrows.

lines.zh: 你在算距离，我在算剂量
lines.en: You measure distance; I measure dose.

lines.zh: 我不需要跑，你跑不出这层
lines.en: No need to sprint; you can't leave this floor.

lines.zh: 绿光落在你脚边，那是在标记
lines.en: Green light at your feet: that's a mark.

lines.zh: 你的盾举得太高，肋骨是空的
lines.en: Shield too high; your ribs are open.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把你的退路压短
lines.en: Step by step, I shorten your retreat.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头响吗，那是我的关节
lines.en: Hear bones creak? Those are my joints.

lines.zh: 我不急，辐射比我更急
lines.en: I'm patient; radiation isn't.

lines.zh: 你换气的间隙，我已经近了半步
lines.en: Between your breaths I close half a step.

lines.zh: 别靠墙，墙上全是热灰
lines.en: Not the wall; it's coated in hot ash.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剑，握反了
lines.en: That sword in your hand is reversed.

lines.zh: 我看你像看一份到期文件
lines.en: I see you as an expired file.

lines.zh: 你跑过热灰，脚印会发光
lines.en: Run across the ash and your prints will glow.

lines.zh: 我把面罩转过来，你就该跑了
lines.en: I turn my mask to you; that is your cue.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在这里会变苦
lines.en: Your breath turns bitter in here.

lines.zh: 我走近一步，地面就烫一分
lines.en: Each step I take heats the floor.

lines.zh: 剑落下去，切口边缘立刻发灰
lines.en: My blade falls; the cut edge greys at once.

lines.zh: 我的剑不快，但每一下都带衰败
lines.en: Slow blade, but every swing carries decay.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，骨头震得发麻
lines.en: You block once; my bones buzz.

lines.zh: 这一剑是给你补的离职手续
lines.en: This swing completes your exit paperwork.

lines.zh: 腐败爬过你的手臂，别浪费力气
lines.en: Rot climbs your arm; don't waste strength.

lines.zh: 我打你的护甲接缝，那里最薄
lines.en: I strike the plate seam; thinnest there.

lines.zh: 你退，我就把剑往前递半寸
lines.en: You retreat; I extend half an inch.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了你的呼吸节奏
lines.en: That blow broke your breathing rhythm.

lines.zh: 我的剑很旧，切过很多人
lines.en: Old blade; it has cut many.

lines.zh: 你砍我一根肋骨，我照样站着
lines.en: You break one rib; I still stand.

lines.zh: 绿色的火星落在你伤口上
lines.en: Green sparks settle in your wound.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊是下层的事
lines.en: I don't shout; shouting is for underlings.

lines.zh: 你跪下去，正好方便我收尾
lines.en: You kneel; convenient for finishing.

lines.zh: 尸体要登记，我稍后处理
lines.en: The body needs logging; I'll handle it later.

lines.zh: 这一剑带着反应堆的温度
lines.en: This blade still carries the reactor's heat.

lines.zh: 你的手一软，剑就掉了
lines.en: Your grip slackens, and the sword drops.

lines.zh: 反应堆重启，我从控制台后走出来
lines.en: The reactor restarts; I step from behind the console.

lines.zh: 绿光扫过地面，我站在光里
lines.en: Green light sweeps the floor; I stand in it.

lines.zh: 这层归我管，从今天起
lines.en: This floor is mine, starting today.

lines.zh: 骨头一节节接上，发出干燥的响
lines.en: Bones connect one by one with a dry click.

lines.zh: 我的剑先落地，然后是我
lines.en: My blade lands first; then I do.

lines.zh: 上任总监的灰还在墙角，我不介意
lines.en: My predecessor's ash is in the corner; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 管道里的冷却液开始变绿
lines.en: The coolant in the pipes turns green.

lines.zh: 我从辐射里凝固成形，很慢，很稳
lines.en: I congeal out of radiation: slow, steady.

lines.zh: 员工名册翻到新一页，第一个是你
lines.en: The roster turns a page; you're first.

lines.zh: 灯灭了半秒，我就到了
lines.en: The lights cut for half a second; I arrive.

lines.zh: 我把剑插进地里，宣布开工
lines.en: I plant my blade and declare the shift open.

lines.zh: 三盏警示灯同时亮，为我让路
lines.en: Three warning lamps light at once, making way.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到，骨头后到
lines.en: My shadow arrives first; the bones follow.

lines.zh: 反应堆区的门开了，别再关上
lines.en: The reactor door opened; don't close it.

lines.zh: 火只会让我的骨头更干
lines.en: Fire only dries my bones further.

lines.zh: 从上层摔下来，骨头散了两根
lines.en: Dropped a floor; two bones came loose.

lines.zh: 冷却液灌进胸腔，滋滋作响
lines.en: Coolant floods my chest and hisses.

lines.zh: 反应堆的余波把我掀翻，我站起来
lines.en: Reactor backblast knocks me down; I rise.

lines.zh: 箭卡在锁骨，像支钢笔
lines.en: An arrow in my collarbone, like a pen.

lines.zh: 法术想净化我，找错了对象
lines.en: Magic tries to cleanse me; wrong subject.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，我只吃这层的空气
lines.en: I don't eat; I consume this floor's air.

lines.zh: 雷顺着管道下来，烧黑我半边
lines.en: Lightning rides the pipe, scorching half of me.

lines.zh: 虚空不在编制内，我不该来
lines.en: The void isn't in the org chart; I shouldn't be here.
